messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for incident-2457: spike in 5xx and latency on /v1/kv/prefix-read — routing to #incidents, severity=sev2 :rotating_light:
alex: seeing a sharp rise in read errors from the prefix cache layer, starts ~2026-11-03T09:50Z
sana: confirmed, dashboards show prefix read errors -> fallback hits increased, backend read QPS stable
maria: oncall here, taking lead. what's the customer impact? any big tenants affected?
ryan: a few enterprise tenants report degraded LLM responses (timeouts -> model fallback). no OOB data loss.
emma: customer-facing metrics: 7 tenants with >5% error rate on inference calls in last 10m. ops sent e-mails to affected accounts.
alex: quick triage: error traces show KV cache returning 500s for certain prefix shard ids 42-47. suspect cache page eviction or paging layer bug.
sana: logs show repeated backend read attempts with paged fetch failing during decompress: "corrupt page checksum" on some cached blobs
maria: okay action plan: 1) immediate mitigation to reduce customer impact 2) investigate root cause 3) coordinate handoffs and comms
alex: mitigation option A: route affected prefix requests to live bypass (direct backend read) — more latency/cost but avoids 5xx. Option B: rate-limit offending prefixes to reduce error amplification.
ryan: recommend A then B if backend starts thrashing. We need a safe toggle in runtime to set prefix->bypass for specific shard range.
emma: can we do granular bypass per-tenant? we should scope to tenant+prefix to avoid global perf hit.
sana: we have runtime flag `kv.prefix_bypass.set(range, mode)` — can target shard ids. I'll prepare the command.
ops-bot: deployment pipeline: canary patch build available: sha=abc123-kv-paging-fix. No hotpatch required for bypass toggle.
maria: alex, can you run the bypass for shard 42-47 scoped to the affected tenants, and monitor error rate and latency?
alex: running: `kvctl set-bypass --shards 42-47 --scope tenants=ten_42,ten_77 --mode direct-read --reason "incident-2457"`
ops-bot: command accepted. change propagated to 3/3 runtime clusters.
ryan: monitoring: within 60s error rate for those tenants drops from 18% -> 2%, p99 latency rises ~120ms. Backend CPU ticked up ~8%.
emma: ack, notify Support to update customer messages: degraded output replaced with slower but successful responses.
pagerduty: On-call handoff reminder: maria will hand to next oncall at 10:15Z.
sana: parallel mitigation: apply temporary quota cap on read QPS for non-enterprise tenants hitting these prefixes to reduce background noise. command: `quotactl update --prefix-shards 42-47 --max-qps 10 --exclude tenants=ten_42,ten_77`
alex: applied quota caps. non-critical tenants see 429 for heavy prefix reads, enterprise tenants unaffected.
ryan: warning: quota caps caused a small uptick in retry storms from some SDKs. enabling soft 429 backoff header in responses to encourage client backoff.
emma: Support confirmed affected customers got update; one enterprise asked for ETA — give them initial RCA and mitigation note.
maria: next steps: 1) keep bypass until corrupt cache pages are scrubbed. 2) schedule background job to scan and fix corrupt blobs (kv-scan job). 3) plan a safe rollback test for the bypass once scrubbed.
sana: kicking off kv-scan: `kv-scan --shards 42-47 --verify --repair --priority high` — expected ETA 3h. I'll attach job id j-9942.
alex: starting scrub job j-9942. will stream findings here.
ops-bot: scrub job j-9942: 0/12k objects repaired. first errors indicate a subset of objects with checksum mismatch.
ryan: Ops note: if repair fails for some objects, we should keep bypass for those specific keys and rehydrate from origin if possible.
emma: comms: drafting status update for affected tenants — will send after we confirm the first 30m of scrub progress.
maria: handoff plan: I'll remain primary until 10:15Z then hand to ryan. ryan will own the rollback decision. If errors <0.5% and repair complete for 90% objects, we can consider toggling off bypass in canary.
alex: logging checklist: add incident tag incident-2457 to all bypass actions and kv-scan events, open internal ticket INC-2457-RCA.
sana: discovered a secondary issue: a bad compaction job last week produced some truncated pages — cleanup will be part of RCA.
ryan: once scrub hits 50%, we should run a small canary: flip bypass off for a single shard (43) for one tenant and monitor p50/p99 and errors for 10m. rollback immediately on regression.
emma: agreed. schedule canary in ~4h or sooner if scrub finishes early.
ops-bot: incident timeline updated: incident-2457 state=mitigated, mitigations=prefix-bypass+quota-caps+kv-scan, owners=[maria,ryan,sana], severity=sevtwo
maria: thanks team. keeping this thread as the single source of truth. if anyone gets paged, recheck this thread first. I'll post handoff message at 10:15Z.
ryan: noted. ping me for rollback runbook if needed.
emma: closing loop with Support: sent interim email to affected tenants. will prepare a customer-friendly RCA after root cause is confirmed.
alex: quick dev note: create follow-up PR to add `kv.report-corrupt-page` metric and an alert when corrupt pages > 5/min.
sana: posting job update: j-9942 progress 14% repaired 1700/12000 objects — errors concentrated on compaction-era blobs.
maria: handoff: taking a breather, handing to ryan now as scheduled. ryan, you're primary. I'll be reachable.
ryan: I have it. continuing monitoring. will coordinate canary when scrub completes.
ops-bot: handoff recorded: from=maria to=ryan at=2026-11-03T10:15Z
